title: Preview panel: behavioral test coverage for client mode-switch + deep-link (beyond static-markup locks)
description: BETA FINDING (TASK-068 reviewer deferred MEDIUM). The preview panel regression locks assert static SSR markup presence; the client-side behavior — applyPreviewMode web/process/none/stopped branching, the SSE handlePreviewEvent dispatch, and the ?tab=preview/#preview deep-link activateTab — has no behavioral coverage (validateLocalhostUrl is now unit-locked via single-source extraction, but the rest of the client logic is not). A future refactor breaking the mode-switch or deep-link would keep all current locks green. Add behavioral coverage (extract testable pure client logic and/or a lightweight DOM/jsdom harness) so the panel behavior is regression-locked, not just its markup.
acceptance_criteria: The mode-switch logic (web->iframe, process->log view, none->hint, stopped->teardown) is exercised by a behavioral test that would fail if a branch were broken, not merely asserting element presence in static HTML.
The ?tab=preview / #preview deep-link tab activation is covered by a test that fails if the deep-link IIFE is removed.
Any extracted client logic uses the established single-source toString-injection pattern (no drift between tested source and shipped client).
tests-after: minimal, each encodes a real behavior; npm run test:all green; rebuild dist if bundled source changes.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Closed as OBSOLETE without work (human-approved direction 2026-07-01, announced at TASK-074 mint): this ticket asked for behavioral test coverage of the console Preview panel client logic (applyPreviewMode, SSE dispatch, ?tab=preview deep-link), but TASK-074 removed the entire preview feature and its panel (commits 8eb43aa/f6ac84e/7a471fa/03f1971), so there is no surface left to cover. No code was written for this ticket.
